document_metrics.selected_filter_definition: Predefined mainRQ2 four-state estimator with Cp state; selected before outcomes, not by posthoc highest hit rate.
document_metrics.authority_scope: Single-run point-mass internal cross-check; values rounded in captured originalstdout. Window effects are not additive.
document_metrics.predictor_scope: Worst all7 cases includes the energy-short Isp-5% case; reachable worst excludes that single unbraked-below9900ft case, retaining drymass+5%.
document_metrics.recovery_scope: Discrete tested Isp factors at fixed fuel, XML controller; not a continuous guaranteed range.

global_sil_tail_extrema.scope: Across all48 SIL configurations; full-ascent RMS and instantaneous absolute errors retain every flight. Shared vehicle prefixes are not independent extra draws.

acceleration_rejection_fraction.unit: fraction of acceleration observations in one flight

protocol.gate_description: Known nominal burn end 3.9s times (1+3*assigned Isp SD .025), then three consecutive negative-specific-force packets in estimator/controller; earliest latch 4.24s. Normal Isp tails beyond 3SD remain possible; true thrust/fuel are offline diagnostics only.
protocol.measurement_repair: Acceleration-only NIS9 rejects incompatible acceleration; barometerNIS is logged without hard rejection because direct counterfactuals proved barometer lockout. AccelerationR adds(.20*a_brake_nominal)^2 from estimatedh/v, known nominal geometry/mass/coefficient and current idealized position feedback fcs/airbrake-pos-norm, never sampled truebrake. Original delayedpacket/currentposition pairing remains uncompensated.
protocol.synthetic_test_fixture: The synthetic coast-only unit test now initializes the mean to its stated known starting h/v; production SIL initial mean remains zero.
protocol.quality_definition: Original three 500-row quality sets, seed1/equal inputs and noise calibrations, all finite full-ascent/landing outputs; no kilometre RMS runaway, improved h/v p95, preserved all-error and ideal hit counts. All tails/misses and rejected observations retained. Full48/16800 and three-path4500 must complete before final RQ2 acceptance.

quality.scope: MC quality gate for the repaired source, not global stability/covariance calibration. No samples are omitted or state magnitudes clipped. Full48 and 4500 diagnostic completion remain required for final RQ2 acceptance.

repair.brake_source: Current idealized brake position feedback, paired with delayed measurements without compensation

three_paths.limitation: ProcessPool reused identical-byte source modules across configs. All jobs copy the same frozen source; accel path and ideal mode are explicitly set. This is not an assertion that each cached module file path belonged to each later job folder. New repair runner uses fresh subprocess and asserts actual paths/hashes.

attribution.scope: Independent sequential attribution of historical-to-v1 ideal hit-rate changes; diagnostic ascent-only runs, not new independent MC or v2 final controller results
attribution.endpoint: First descending 50Hz sample after SIL burnout latch, with actual apogee tracked every1ms; no ground/recovery claim

historical_reproduction.scope: Numerical per-sample reproduction within the stated tolerance; not bitwise identical apogee floats.

motor_mechanism.interpretation: Correcting the mass-indexed interpolation changes thrust-time shape/burn duration even when total impulse is almost unchanged; zero noise cannot undo this physical-model change.

phase_mechanism.selected_cases: First two within100 losses in the prespecified twelve-case corrected pilot, separately per estimator; post-hoc mechanism replay, not extra independent MC
phase_mechanism.interpretation: Compare coast latch and remaining thrust/fuel before depletion to distinguish physical apogee shifts from filter/controller mode changes. Instrumentation reads additional properties and changes no calculations or RNG; replay apogee is asserted exactly equal to the noninstrumented pilot.

input_pairing.semantic_change: prop_mass normal draw becomes fixed-fuel Isp normal draw

caveats: Sequential decomposition is conditional on this order and combines physically related corrections; it does not uniquely assign all interactions.
Motor group also uses the precision-preserving template writer and exact corresponding tank endpoint; filter/controller laws remain unchanged.
Early-coast evidence uses two post-hoc pilot losses, sample0/5; it demonstrates the mechanism but is not an estimate of its prevalence over all500.
All diagnostic configurations are frozen v1/original snapshots. They must not replace the v2 corrected production results.
The erroneous earlier module-cache attempts are explicitly SUPERSEDED and excluded.

decomposition.conclusion: Barometer hard rejection creates the ideal sample186 lockout: phase-only and derivedRbrake-only recover this case, baro-only and joint gate do not. Acceleration-only hard gate without Rbrake still leaves old all-error tail382; thus its confidence model also needs the declared brake model variance. Finite hit losses109/406/62 persist withRbrake alone and are retained as real configuration changes. No threshold/R grid search was used.
decomposition.scope: Exact same-source/seed development counterfactuals selected from observed failures, not independent test data or additional mainMC denominator. All prototypes, failed scientific quality gates and outputs retained. Finalsource must pass separate three500 quality then full48.
